messages:
zoe_marketing: Hey team — we want to lock the announce for next Thu 15:00 PT. Need final changelog bullets, canonical docs URL, canary timing, and HubSpot form for webinar reg.

gabe_engineering: Staged rollout is fine. Proposed: 20m smoke -> 80m canary -> gradual ramp. Canary start 2026-03-30T04:00:00Z. End criteria: rollback on 5xx >1.2% for 9m or median latency +22%.

rachel_docs: Docs preview available: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/release/2026-orbit. Changelog draft includes migration notes. If merged, canonical will be https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-orbit. Note: model pinning remains behind `enable_model_pinning`. Will add a callout.

omar_product: Merge docs before the announcement if feasible. Also add: "Dedicated customers — contact CS for assisted upgrades."

mike_sales: HubSpot form ready: https://hub.redwood.ai/forms/orbit-release. Tags: "orbit-2026" and "orbit-webinar". We can auto-add "benchmark" tag for blog-origin leads.

zoe_marketing: Draft social copy: "Meet Orbit: faster cold-starts, optional model pinning, and smarter batching. Read the changelog + docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-orbit. Join our webinar for demos + Q&A." Need the bench PNG (latency v token) for the blog hero.

gabe_engineering: Perf team will export median latency image by EOD tomorrow and attach. Canary endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, /v1/chat. Throttle canary to 10rps, ramp to 45rps.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: smoke 2026-03-30T03:30:00Z; canary 2026-03-30T04:00:00Z -> 2026-03-30T05:20:00Z; ramp 2026-03-30T06:00:00Z. Rollback rules: see gabe_engineering.

zoe_marketing: OK checklist to lock publish: 1) canonical docs URL (rachel), 2) bench PNG (gabe), 3) canary endpoints + thresholds (gabe), 4) HubSpot form + tags (mike). If all green we schedule announce 2026-03-30 15:00 PT.

rachel_docs: I will merge the docs PR after a final proof at 2026-03-29 20:00 PT and post the canonical link here; will also add the model_pinning callout.

gabe_engineering: PNG uploaded: https://files.redwood.ai/perf/orbit-median-latency.png. All staging tests pass.

zoe_marketing: Perfect  locking campaign and starting creative. If anything changes, tag @marketing-alert in this thread. Thanks!
